title: Round 3: recurrent TD3+BC net2 on net1 v5 with the held u, three seeds
description: The held-decision graph now holds a decision's realized u and aims each step's window at 2^u times that step's believed BDP (85de8d0); holding the window instead cost the untrained clone 0.121 against the rule as copies, which accounts for most of the copies loss at both earlier gates. The TD3+BC fallback (src/expliccit_env/train/ppo.py, algo td3bc), on the same rollouts as exp-net2-ppo-flows: the recurrent actor cloned from the fixed rule (u = 0.25 on net1 v5), held decisions, the competition mix (80% of the links, Cubic, BBR or 2 or 4 copies), the team reward for copies, and twin Q networks on the true LCFs, the counts of other flows and the action. The actor follows the gradient of Q at each state, weighted alpha, against its distance to the actions taken in units of the exploration noise (sigma = 0.05), from a replay of the last 8 iterations, 200 updates each. PPO's likelihood-ratio gradient learned no dependence on the state (exp-net2-ppo-gate-99); the critic's gradient gives one per state. alpha 10 or 40, seeds 1, 2 and 3, 60 iterations, tau = 1 s, evaluated noise-free every 20 on the validation links' new-conditions family. The policies go to the same gate (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py, campaign seed 21). Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r3td3-a$ALPHA-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson a "$ALPHA" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "td3bc" | .alpha = $a | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r3td3-a$ALPHA-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
